# Canopy Laplace-solve reference data — solid-harmonic far field, P = 6.
#
# Consumed by tests/tstLaplaceSolve.hpp (CTest target
# Canopy_Test_LaplaceSolve_MPI_<DEV>). These are bit patterns, not values:
# they are only meaningful for the exact configuration frozen in
# tstLaplaceSolve.hpp — P = 6, NComps = 1, Scalar = double, mac_theta = 0.5,
# ncrit = 16, max_depth = 6, replication_depth = 2,
# imbalance_tolerance = 0.05, all six box tolerances and ncrit_tol = 0.1,
# softening = 0.0, dt = 1.0e-4, drift_multiplier = 1.0, num_steps = 12,
# migrate() between steps — solved on the SERIAL backend.
#
# The particle set is a GLOBAL set of 600 from seed 1234 + P, generated
# identically on every rank at every rank count and sliced contiguously:
# positions uniform on [0.05, 0.95], charges uniform on [0.5, 1.5] — one
# signed — velocities zero, one position triple then one charge drawn per
# particle. That is what makes the np=k-versus-np=1 comparison definable at
# all, and what makes the `initial` hash below exact by construction.
#
# num_steps = 12 was chosen by measurement, not asserted: a 50-step trace of
# this configuration first trips a degeneracy test at step 18 (max |grad phi|
# 3.81e+06 against 8.60e+03 at step 0), and 12 is two thirds of that rounded
# down. At the 12th solve the tree is 103 cells with 724 realized M2L
# operators at np=1 and 393/462 at np=2, so the far field really is evaluated
# at the step every record below is taken from.
#
# Only three bit-for-bit records are held — (nprocs, rank) of (1,0), (2,0)
# and (2,1). The np 3-6 gate is cross-rank agreement against the np=1 `field`
# record, plus the direct sum; the bitwise gate stays at np 1-2 (README
# "Known Issues", the cell partition's reproducibility). The `field` record is np=1 only: that run is bit-reproducible,
# which is what makes committing its output meaningful. The last-step
# positions are NOT bit-identical across rank counts, which is why the drift
# check hashes the INITIAL set instead.
#
# Provenance
# ----------
# All three records, `initial` and `field`: regenerated at commit 6c80b2f,
#   the analytic L2P gradient (tasks/canopy0-progress-log.md, C11), flux job
#   f3cvgaNGZL3H, on tuolumne, Cray clang 20.0.0, spack env
#   tuolumne_trilinos, RelWithDebInfo, Kokkos SERIAL backend. Only the three
#   `locals` hashes and the `field` record changed; `initial`, `optab`,
#   `keys`, `fallback` and `atable` came out byte-identical to the records
#   before it (F4 job f3cP3HeeQ4oZ; H2 job f3cY5dZ6SgwH for the np-2 records
#   on the ParMETIS cell partition).
# Regenerate with scripts/tuolumne/run_laplace_solve_regenerate.flux, merge
# the three .part files in the order (1,0), (2,0), (2,1) under this header,
# and record the new commit and the reason in the progress log of the task
# that regenerates it. Nothing in the default test
# path writes this file.
#
# Format
# ------
# '#' begins a comment, to end of line. Whitespace-separated tokens; the line
# breaks below are cosmetic. Records dispatch on their leading token and may
# appear in any order.
#
#   initial  <hash>                        FNV-1a-64 over the initial global
#                                          particle set: 600 position triples
#                                          then 600 charges, in global index
#                                          order. Checked before anything
#                                          else, so a generator drift fails
#                                          with one message instead of 600
#                                          value mismatches.
#
#   field    <n>                           the np=1 field after the last
#   f <pot> <gx> <gy> <gz>   (x n)         solve, in canonical GlobalId
#   endfield                               order, as bit patterns
#
# One bit-for-bit record per (nprocs, rank):
#
#   set      <nprocs> <rank>
#   locals   <ext0> <ext1> <ext2> <hash>   DownwardSweep::locals()
#   optab    <ext0> <ext1> <ext2> <hash>   M2L operator table; the hash covers
#                                          the first <nops> columns only, the
#                                          rest of extent 2 being an
#                                          uninitialized pad
#   nops     <n>                           n_unique_ops, full value; asserted
#                                          to be > 0, since a degenerate tree
#                                          realizes zero operators and makes
#                                          every check here pass vacuously
#   keys     <hash>                        realized M2L key list, sorted by
#                                          (dd, ii, jj, kk)
#   fallback <n>                           total_fallback_pair_count(); 0 for
#                                          this configuration, and asserted to
#                                          be 0 rather than pinned (see R4)
#   atable   <extent>                      A_{n,m} table, (2P+1)^2 entries
#   a        <bits> x4 ...                 full bit patterns, four per line
#   end
#
# Every <hash> is the in-repo FNV-1a-64 of tstLaplaceSolve.hpp fed
# big-endian, and every <bits> is the IEEE-754 bit pattern of a double as a
# uint64_t. Neither is a value comparison: EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ has a tolerance
# and NaN != NaN, so neither can serve as a bitwise gate.

set 1 0
locals 103 28 1 0x42b23ad351d8b66b
optab 28 49 724 0x7bca4069b87e18c3
nops 724
keys 0xec8dad3837ded36b
fallback 0
atable 169
